levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ ... قَالا» : the bare father is a relation, co-transmitting with Muhammad b. al-Hasan. «قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» is Muhammad b. Muslim's own question; the Imam answers, so he is the last link (rule 5, imam_in_text). «9-» is numbering; «رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا» and «ع» are blessings.
